description: This Java class 'CorsConfig' provides global CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) configuration for a Spring Boot application. It defines allowed origins, methods, headers, and exposed headers to control access to API endpoints, including documentation and Swagger UI. The class includes bean definitions for WebMvcConfigurer and CorsConfigurationSource to integrate with Spring MVC and Spring Security, applying consistent CORS policies.

classes.name: CorsConfig
classes.description: Configuration class that sets up global CORS policies for the Spring Boot application.

methods.name: corsConfigurer
methods.description: Defines a WebMvcConfigurer bean that applies CORS settings to all endpoints.

methods.name: corsConfigurationSource
methods.description: Creates a CorsConfigurationSource bean used by Spring Security to enforce CORS rules.
